Rômulo Zanre Zwarg (born 1 March 2000), also known as Rômulo Zanre or simply Rômulo, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder for Liga MX club Tigres UANL.
Career
From 2018 to 2019, Rômulo played for the Brazilian Série A side Cruzeiro on loan from Paulista Série A3 side Desportivo Brasil, where he made appearances for the youth team and was only called up to two Série A matches. After ending his loan, on 2020 season he was transferred to the Chilean Primera División club Deportes La Serena, scoring his first goal at professional level on 21 December 2020.
On 7 January 2022, Rômulo returned to his home country after agreeing to a loan deal with Juventude. He featured rarely as the club suffered relegation, before being announced at Athletic-MG on 9 January 2023.
On 12 April 2023, Rômulo was announced at Internacional on loan until the end of the year.
On 14 January 2024, Inter executed the buy-clause and announced Rômulo was officially Internacional's player until the end of 2027.
On 26 January 2025, Mexican club Tigres UANL announced Rômulo as their new signing.
